dataset: Stanford Online Products official training images only; official test metadata validated but no official test image bytes decoded
split: seed-179019 class-disjoint 90/10 split on SOP train identities; 32 evenly spaced holdout query images; all 59551 training archive rows except those 32 form the 59519-row gallery
shared_fit: centered PCA-128 on normalized original L/14 fit-identity outputs only, held fixed across both query arms
gallery: one shared resident original-encoder 130-byte signed-int8 gallery; asymmetric query-path diagnostic, not a symmetric product claim
timing: exactly 10 alternating blocks x 10 calls per arm at batch 1 and 32 after 5 warmups per arm; decode through released RC4 native packed top-10

decision.statistic: median of 100 full image-to-top-k calls for exact-fused divided by original, separately at batch 1 and 32
decision.bootstrap: 5000 paired 10-call block resamples with replacement, seed 179019, 95th percentile with higher interpolation; one-sided upper 95% bound
decision.advance: upper bound < 1 at both batches and no native top-1 ordinal change among all 32 predeclared queries
decision.oracle: both arms, all 32 queries, full scalar signed-int8 scan with gallery-ordinal tie breaking, matched to native batch-32 output; timed batch-1 and batch-32 top-1 must match
